notes: §2002:7.2.19.2 SR3 (and §2014:7.3.20.2 SR3 the same) refuses an exception-name written more than once in one TURN directive; §2023:7.3.25.3 SR3 refuses only a repeated exception-name and file-name combination. TurnDirectiveProcessor.ParseTurn keeps a set of the names written and, where DialectBehavior.TurnDirectiveRepeatsOnlyNameFileCombination is not active (below 2023; VCR 7.126), reports COBOL0718 for the second spelling of a name, whatever file-names follow; the pair set that stays at every edition is SR4's (2002/2014) and SR3's (2023) rule, so a name repeated reports once. kb/Work PB5725.
